possible_answers.answer: 1.	Chronic cardiac conditions: Present or past heart failure, cardiomyopathy (any type), Congenital valvular/heart diseases with or without treatment
2.	Chronic pulmonary conditions: Present or past history of Interstitial lung disease, Severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (GOLD 3 and above)
3.	Chronic neurological diseases: Present or past history of severe cerebrovascular events with residual neurological deficits, Recurrent CVA, Neurode
4.	Chronic Gastrointestinal disorders: Present or past history of Chronic liver disease (Stage 2 and above), chronic pancreatitis, Inflammatory bowel
6.	Any patient diagnosed with autoimmune disorders
7.	Any patient who is the recipient of organ transplantation

project.description: Longevity India's BHARAT (Biomarkers of Healthy Ageing, Resilience and Transitions) Study is a multi-modal, multi-omic population cohort study to identify biomarkers and drivers of ageing in the Indian population.
